algorithm: The Lucas sequence starts with L_0 = 2 and L_1 = 1. For n >= 2, each subsequent Lucas number is computed as L_n = L_{n-1} + L_{n-2}.
Iteratively compute the Lucas numbers from L_0 up to L_n using dynamic programming, storing only the last two values to minimize memory usage.
constraints: n must be an integer between 0 and 100 inclusive
The result must be an exact Python integer with arbitrary precision (no symbolic expressions)
inputs: n: integer in the range 0 to 100 inclusive
output: The n-th Lucas number as an exact Python integer (arbitrary precision)
purpose: Compute the n-th Lucas number using integer arithmetic with arbitrary precision
